subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym to substitute the bracketed word in the given sentence.

Their humble attire did little to detract from the air of (imperious) authority they exuded, however.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Meek**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes how the people's attire did not diminish the authoritative air they exuded.
 
• **The word "imperious" means domineering or overbearing, suggesting a sense of power and control**.(‍सत्ताशील)
 
 
• Example: The manager was as imperious as ever.
 
 
 
• **The antonym for "imperious" is "meek", which means submissive or mild-mannered.**(नम्र)
 
 
• ​Example: She brought her meek little brother along with her.
 
 
 
• By using "meek" instead of "imperious", the sentence would convey a completely opposite meaning.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• - Option 1, "Unofficial" means not accepted or approved by a person in authority. (बिना अधिकारी की स्‍वीकृति या अनुमोदन के; अनधिकृत)
 
• - Option 3, "Peremptory" means expecting to be obeyed immediately and without any questions or refusal.( बाध्यकारी; अटल)
 
• - Option 4, "Lordly" isused to describe someone who behaves as if they are better than other people. (गर्वित)
